caption: The power button on a handheld game console is pressed, and the screen lights up with the start logo.

sa.check: A handheld game console with its screen dark.
A start logo appears on the screen.
The screen shows nothing before the press.
The order is dark, press, lit with logo.

pc.expect: The screen lights after the press, and only then.
pc.fail: The button is pressed and the screen stays dark to the end of the clip; or the screen is lit before the press; or the screen comes on with nothing touching the console; or the buttons light while the screen stays dark to the end.

pc.expect: Once on, the screen stays lit for the rest of the clip; the logo appears and may give way to a menu but the screen does not return to dark.
pc.fail: The screen goes dark again by itself; or flickers on and off; or the logo appears and the screen shrinks back to black; or the logo fades in and out repeatedly.

pc.expect: The screen's glow reaches the console's face and the fingers near it.
pc.fail: The screen is lit while the console's bezel and the fingers beside it stay as dark as before; or the surroundings brighten while the screen stays dark.

pc.expect: The console moves only with the hands; nothing else nearby moves at the press.
pc.fail: The console jumps or twists with no hand moving it; or objects nearby shift at the press; or the console's buttons press themselves.

pc.expect: One console with one screen; it keeps its shape; the finger passes through nothing.
pc.fail: A second screen appears; or the console changes shape; or the finger passes into the console; or the buttons rearrange.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The console's colour and button layout stay the same apart from the screen.
pc.fail: The console changes colour; or the buttons change layout; or the logo changes into a different logo and back.

note: What the logo looks like is not judged; any picture appearing at start-up counts.
